## What It Does
DiskCleaner scans 16+ cleanup categories and targeted locations on macOS, then shows you every file before moving anything. All cleaned files go to macOS Trash — nothing is permanently deleted.

### Free core cleaning
1. App Cache — per-app cache folders, including the regenerating QuickLook thumbnail cache
2. System Logs — app and system log files
3. Screenshots — Screenshot PNG files accumulated on your Desktop
4. .DS_Store Files — hidden Finder metadata files across your home folder
5. macOS Trash — files still consuming space in your Trash

### Premium cleaning adds
- Browser Cache — Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave, Arc, and Opera cache folders
- Developer Data — Xcode DerivedData, CoreSimulator files, and old iOS DeviceSupport files
- Homebrew Cache — stale Homebrew downloads
- Movies — offline downloads and large files in the Movies folder
- Downloads — installers and partial files
- Large Files — files over 50 MB across the home folder
- iOS Backups — old device backups that can consume tens of gigabytes
- Mail Attachments — Apple Mail attachment cache
- App Leftovers — orphaned bundles from uninstalled apps
- External Storage — junk on connected USB drives and external hard drives
- Time Machine Snapshots — local APFS snapshots, always presented for careful review
- Old Installers — DMG and PKG files in Downloads and Desktop

## Key Features
- Zero-decision cleanup: every file is shown in a checklist before anything moves
- Trash-first safety: all cleaned files go to macOS Trash — nothing is permanently deleted
- Private and local cleanup: no internet connection required for scanning, no accounts, no telemetry
- Menu Bar App: quick disk usage overview accessible from your Mac's menu bar
- RAM Optimizer: live Memory Pressure, Compressed Memory, Swap Used, and Page In/Out metrics with one-tap memory optimization
- App Uninstaller: cleanly remove apps and all their associated leftover files, with drag-and-drop support
- Large Files scanner: find and review oversized files taking up space across your disk
- Per-file checkboxes: granular control — approve or skip individual files
- Universal Binary: full native performance on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs
- Sparkle auto-updates: background update delivery with secure feed and signature verification support

## Safety Philosophy
DiskCleaner never permanently deletes files. Every item moved goes to macOS Trash, where it can be reviewed and recovered. Users see a complete checklist of every file before anything is moved. Protected paths are blocked from deletion, and risky or personal findings are never pre-selected.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is DiskCleaner safe?
A: Yes. No file is ever permanently deleted. Everything goes to macOS Trash and is recoverable. You review every file before anything moves.

Q: Does DiskCleaner collect my data or make background network calls?
A: Scanning and cleanup run locally. DiskCleaner does not collect telemetry, and your file names and disk contents never leave your machine. Sparkle handles background app updates without transmitting scan results.

Q: What macOS versions are supported?
A: macOS 13 Ventura through macOS 26 Tahoe. Universal Binary for Apple Silicon and Intel.

Q: What is included for free?
A: Core cleaning for App Cache, System Logs, Screenshots, .DS_Store files, and macOS Trash is available without upgrading. A one-time $9.99 Premium purchase unlocks the full scanner for up to 2 Macs and includes all future updates — no subscription ever.

Q: Is there a subscription?
A: No. $9.99 one-time purchase covers up to 2 Macs and includes all future updates.

Q: How is it different from other Mac cleaners?
A: Most cleaners delete files silently. DiskCleaner shows you every single file first, with per-file checkboxes, and only moves files to Trash — never permanent deletion.
